test_vectors.coverage: All seven tags, both boolean values, exact numeric and escaped string spellings, complete container spans, external whitespace, root ownership and absence of a parent.
Every valid node index, last valid node, first invalid index, larger invalid indices, u32::MAX - 1, NO_NODE and single-node documents.
Nine-node mixed tree with exact preorder IDs, parent links, immediate child counts, subtree-skipping sibling traversal, object members, zero-based array lookup and usize::MAX rejection.
Empty array and object roots, nested empty containers, empty lookups, exact zero size hints and repeated exhausted next calls.
Partial consumption, independent cloned positions, exact remaining counts, nth across subtrees, nth(usize::MAX), count, last and fused exhaustion.
Member order, nested containers excluded from field count, cloned iterators, exact remaining counts, nth(usize::MAX), count, last and fused exhaustion.
A bounded prefix with a continuing sibling link stops at its stored count; zero remaining prevents even a sentinel next field from being dereferenced.
Allowed duplicates with raw and escaped first keys, first-match lookup, complete duplicate iteration, case sensitivity and rejection of literal escape spellings as cooked keys.
Empty keys, embedded NUL, newline, quote, backslash, slash, surrogate-pair emoji, composed and decomposed Unicode, exact matching and borrowed key storage.
Every mismatched object and array conversion, all scalar children errors, leading-whitespace and nested absolute offsets, TypeMismatch code, Dom source and initialized diagnostic metadata.
Cloned documents have distinct handle owners; member and child views retain their selected owner; cloned decoded keys and strings remain accessible after the original is dropped.
256 nested arrays traversed downward and upward, terminal scalar mismatch, and 257 immediate empty-array children with exact counts and final-index boundaries.

status.verification: Source manually reviewed against the frozen DOM contract, root definitions, ABI definitions and Wave 1 builder. No build, check, formatter, compiler or test command was run, as instructed.
status.scope: Only crates/jmax-dom/src/navigate.rs and reports/wave2/W2-15.json were written.
status.behavior: Navigation allocates no storage, does not reparse or mutate documents, preserves decoded first-duplicate lookup, and exposes count-bounded exact-size fused iterators. No unsafe code or additional dependencies were introduced.
